review_description: I am a solar supporter. That's why I paid thousands $ for a RedEarth 5kW BushChook battery when I installed my solar PV panels (which came from another manufacturer). The PV panels are great, but the battery is useless.I tried the recommended RedEarth EMU app, which is supposed to allow users to set up electricity tariffs and presumable control when the battery charges or discharges (ie: sends power to the house or to the grid).After several attempts, the app refused to accept my electricity tariffs info, and is now showing only 5 cents/kWh export price and ZERO cents/kWh for buy price (from the grid).I complained to RedEarth "support" but nothing has been fixed. DISAPPOINTING.So my RedEarth battery charges and recharges continually. It remains at 100% charge always. And I get NO BENEFIT from the 16kWh of power stored in the battery. I can't draw power from it after sunset. I can't export any of the power from the battery back into the grid. IT IS USELESS.C'mon @RedEarth ... you can do better than this. Please fix the RedEarth EMU app so that customers can set up CORRECT ELECTRICITY TARIFFS for import and export. And so that customers can CONTROL THE BATTERY charges and discharges!!

We went with a RedEarth “Sunrise” 3-phase package (≈32 kWh) for about $50,000ish AUD. It failed in Nov 2024 (2.5 years after install) and has never returned to spec.• Endless delays – First “waiting for a diagnostic laptop”, then, “waiting for a shipment”(no batteries in the Country and took 7 months!), then, “waiting for serial numbers”. Every deadline slipped without warning and went unknown without us chasing it up.• Goal-posts moved on the day – The installer finally arrived to swap six batteries, only to discover RedEarth hadn’t even identified which batteries were faulty. He was asked to run diagnostics on site with software he hadn’t been provided. Despite being told they would just tell him which serial numbers were the faulty batteries, and it would be simple.They ended up having to remove ALL 9 batteries in the unit. Leaving me with 6 new ones. Despite requesting they replace all 9 from the start and being told it wasn’t required.• Half a fix offered – After more than 7 months they fitted six batteries out of nine and expected me to run the system on the bare minimum, with no clear date for the remaining three.• Refund run-around – I’ve formally requested a refund, but RedEarth (manufacturer) and retailer. Each point to the other when it comes to responsibility. The customer is left in limbo while they argue over who pays.• Left to chase agencies myself – I’ve had to involve the Office of Fair Trading while RedEarth issue stock apologies and deliver nothing concrete, or what would be considered acceptable after this amount of time.If you value reliability, spare parts and credible after-sales support, avoid RedEarth. My “Australian-made” battery system has spent eight months as expensive garden art while power bills climb, and excuses keep coming. Spend your money with a company that stands behind its product. Have now engaged a legal firm to deal with this.

I had decided to trust my solar installation to Red Earth after dealing with them from April 2020 to May 2023. Boldly proclaimed on the bottom of 8 emails from Red Earth are the words "Design and Installation" and included in the emails is a reference to "our electrician". I was disappointed to then be told to make my payments to Rilec Industries. Reluctantly I followed their instruction and 9 months later my system had not been installed. I cancelled the order and requested the return of my funds, but have had no response from Rilec. Red Earth will not assist. I will now take my case against Red Earth and Rilec to VCAT seeking the return of the large amount of money.

Just wanted to say thank you for supplying and installing the OFF-GRID DropBear system at our property in Avoca Victoria.While there were a few delays in completing installation mostly due to COVID, the system performs incredibly well and so much better than we ever expected it to.   We have been able to live in the property without making any compromises to our lifestyle and how we use electricity.  We have been able to install two large split systems air conditioners which are used for both heating and cooling, dishwasher, washing machine, electric heat pump hot water system, electric water pumps, and all the usual household loads without any issues.   In fact we are seldom able to use all the electricity generated by the solar panels in a day, especially in summer.  The backup generator has only kicked in only twice and was due to very extreme/unusual energy use.   We manually force the generator to start occasionally to ensure it turns over and its reliable.Thanks for a great system, we absolutely love living off grid

Provided with a detailed quote and explanations and brochures etc. I designed my shed around this system and had additional supports added during construction.Installation was a breeze. It took less than 24 hours. Quality is impossible to flaw (being an ex-electrician). Bloody fast and on time. Again, I could not be happier.Customer service has been also flawless.
